turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Good. I'll want a copy of it, and an answer to my question.
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
I haven't said a word about legal action. Was Owen heard first, yes or no?
I always do. You're the one who hasn't chosen any yet.
